name: When should plumbing sub-trade coordination begin in a construction project?

mainEntity.name: When should plumbing sub-trade coordination begin in a construction project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plumbing sub-trade coordination should ideally begin during the project's planning and design phase. Engaging plumbing experts early allows for their input on constructability, cost-saving opportunities, and potential clashes with other systems before construction even starts. This proactive approach helps refine designs, develop a realistic schedule, and address potential issues on paper rather than encountering costly surprises during the build. For new construction or major renovations, early involvement is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Coordination should begin during the project's planning and design phase to integrate plumbing expertise early and prevent future issues.
